metadata.description: Short lowercase base name for all resources (e.g. dronefleet).
Primary Azure region.
Optional backend/Function compute region. Empty co-locates compute with the primary region.
Optional Cosmos DB region. Empty co-locates Cosmos DB with the primary region.
Optional seed to regenerate all globally-unique names. Change this (e.g. "v2") if you ever hit a "name already taken" clash; leave empty for stable, idempotent names.

How application traffic reaches data services. privateEndpoint uses private IPs; serviceEndpoint uses subnet ACLs. IoT Hub routes use deny-by-default public endpoints with trusted-service exceptions in both modes.
Layer F — AI / vision (OpenAI, vision, Logic App).
Microsoft Foundry region. East US 2 is the default because it supports both the snapshot-analysis and real-time voice models.
Stable deployment name used by the backend for snapshot visual analysis.
Foundry model used for snapshot visual analysis.
Foundry snapshot-analysis model version.
Automatic version upgrade policy within the selected snapshot-analysis model family. Cross-family migrations still require a template release.
Foundry gpt-realtime model version.
Usage-based capacity assigned to each Foundry model deployment.
Application (client) ID of the Entra API registration that exposes Drone.Provision. Leave empty only for an initial infrastructure preview; authentication fails closed when deployed empty.
Application (client) ID of the public client registration used by the browser and Android apps.
Delegated scope name required in pilot access tokens.
Comma-separated immutable pilot subject IDs with fleet-admin access.
Comma-separated tenantId:userObjectId bootstrap administrators. Required by deployment tooling so a new tenant cannot be locked out.
Primary drone used by legacy single-device endpoints.
Optional HTTPS endpoint of the GPU YOLO service.
Creates the target ACR and South Central US GPU Container Apps environment. Requires Microsoft.App T4 quota.
Creates the GPU detector app after its image has been imported into the target ACR.
GPU Container Apps region. Empty uses the primary region.
Repository in the deployment-created ACR containing the detector image.
Detector image tag in the deployment-created ACR.
Optional external writable Blob container URL used by ACS recording. Empty uses the deployment ADLS recordings container through ACS managed identity.
Optional shared key used by the external YOLO service. Supply through the deployment command, never commit it.
Tags applied to every resource.
Comma-separated tenantId:userObjectId bootstrap administrators. Does not create pilot assignment documents.
Creates the GPU registry and serverless T4 environment. Requires approved Managed Environment Consumption T4 GPUs quota.
Creates the scale-to-zero detector app after its image is published. Requires deployGpuInfrastructure and an AI shared key.
Region with Container Apps serverless T4 support and approved subscription quota.
Optional peered compute VNet that also needs private DNS resolution.
